comment: Sensitive config / non-prod leak locators in JS (0.47.0; trimmed 0.52.0). Scanned against JS bodies only. Passive; the 'note' says how to use the lead. Bounded spans (ReDoS; S3/Azure shapes mirror the 0.41.2-audited secrets.json bounds). Reported non-sensitive.

patterns.name: Internal/non-prod host URL
patterns.note: add this host to scope and probe it -- staging/internal tiers often have weaker auth, debug endpoints, or stale data

patterns.name: Hardcoded API base URL
patterns.note: this is the API origin the app talks to -- enumerate/attack it directly, and check for other envs on the same host pattern

patterns.name: Cloud storage bucket reference
patterns.note: check the bucket/container for public listing or unauthenticated object read/write
